title: OA SETTING - the Kara-Tur overview: the chapter intro, the geography walk, and the population walk
audit_comment: OA round one hundred forty-seven (capture pp. 301-303): the Chapter 14 intro and Geography prose of pp. 301-302 riding as advisory doctrine, and the Population prose of pp. 302-303 - the four empires, the terrain walk from the Land of Snow Demons to the southern jungles, the peoples from the Shou Lung to the snake empire remnant, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA SETTING - THE KARA-TUR OVERVIEW INTRO, GEOGRAPHY, AND POPULATION, printed capture pp. 301-303 - the setting chapter opens
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 213 closed, 22 open - the Population box flips (census 682 -> 683); NEXT - R761: Shou Lung (capture p. 303), prefix dlw (verify free at the landing), audit "R761 OA Shou Lung audit", include after rules/oa131karaturintro.h

consts.name: dlvMainEmpireCount
consts.comment: the main empire count - the four main empires of Kara-Tur, the Shou Lung, the Tu Lung, the Kozakura, and the Wa (print capture p. 301)

consts.name: dlvBasinRiverCount
consts.comment: the basin river count - the three major rivers of the basin, the Ch'ing Tung, the Hungsete, and the Fenghsintzu (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvVastContinentalArea
bools.comment: the vast continental area - the tremendous range of climates, terrains, governments, societies, cultures, and beliefs, the general overview given as the beginning basis for an Oriental campaign (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvShouLungEmpire
bools.comment: the Shou Lung empire - the first of the four main empires (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvTuLungEmpire
bools.comment: the Tu Lung empire - the second of the four (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvKozakuraEmpire
bools.comment: the Kozakura empire - the third of the four (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvWaEmpire
bools.comment: the Wa empire - the fourth of the four (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvSurroundingUnits
bools.comment: the surrounding political units - the uncivilized tribes, the tribal confederations, the warlord domains, the petty kingdoms, and the trading outposts, the alliances and the independents (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvWildernessTracts
bools.comment: the wilderness tracts - the unsettled and inhospitable lands of the hardy settlers, the bandits, the head-hunters, the non-human societies, and the monsters (print capture p. 301)

bools.name: dlvEveryTerrain
bools.comment: the terrain range - virtually every type of terrain commonly found in our world within the boundaries (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvLandOfSnowDemons
bools.comment: the Land of Snow Demons - the far northern permafrost tundra, the long harsh winters and the cool short summers (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvNorthernWoods
bools.comment: the northern woods - the thickly-wooded and swampy pine lands rich in wildlife south of the permafrost (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvKoryazMountains
bools.comment: the Koryaz Mountains - the series of low mountain ranges of the rising south, the barrier of the Chukei Plateau (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvAmaBasin
bools.comment: the Ama Basin - the network of streams, lakes, and swamps feeding the Ama River, the raging spring torrent of the melting snow (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvCelestialSea
bools.comment: the Celestial Sea - the sea the Ama drains into at its northern end (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvDesertOfHorses
bools.comment: the Desert of Horses - the drier steppes beyond the foothills, the thousands of flat square miles variously known as the Beastlands (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvNortheastPeninsula
bools.comment: the northeast peninsula - the continent curving around the northern end of the Celestial Sea, the rugged islands of Wa and Kozakura breaking from its tip, the mild temperate climate of the warm currents (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvChukeiPlateau
bools.comment: the Chukei Plateau - the high plain of the northern provinces of Chukei and Pyint'sien, once fertile, now the dusty cold wind-swept plateau of the changed weather and the poor land management (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvThreeRiverBasin
bools.comment: the Three-River Basin - the main river basin of Kara-Tur, the fertile floodplains, the three rivers tumbling to the Celestial Sea, the warm temperate to sub-tropical weather (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvPeerlessMountains
bools.comment: the Peerless Mountains - the Wu Pi Te Shan Mo, the towering heights, the lush lower slopes and the jagged frozen peaks (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvSouthernJungles
bools.comment: the southern jungles - the volcanic chain and the fully tropical thick verdant jungles of the strange creatures, the feathery peninsulas of the Eastern Ocean (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvPopulationConcentration
bools.comment: the population concentration - the majority within the Three-River Basin, its surrounding foothills, and the islands of Wa and Kozakura (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvShouLungPopulation
bools.comment: the Shou Lung population - the empire centered in the basin and extending west and north, nearly all arable land farmed, the herding of the Chukei Plateau, the ores of the Peerless and Koryaz mountains (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvTuLungPopulation
bools.comment: the Tu Lung population - the empire along the southern and southwestern basin, the farming of the Fenghsintzu banks, the lumbering of the southern hills (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvAmaNomads
bools.comment: the Ama Basin nomads - the nomadic hunters of little farming, the elk and reindeer herds (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvSnowDemonTribes
bools.comment: the Snow Demon tribes - the few human tribes surviving on the seal, bear, and reindeer hunting (print capture p. 302)

bools.name: dlvHorseTribesConfederation
bools.comment: the horse tribes - the nomadic horsemen of the Desert of Horses in a loose confederation, a strong leader recently welding them into a fierce warrior-nation (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlvPettyKingdomsTributary
bools.comment: the petty kingdoms - the several on the lower peninsula, the tributary states of the Shou Lung Empire (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlvPrimitiveFishermen
bools.comment: the primitive fishermen - the tribes on the islands between the peninsula and the islands of Wa and Kozakura (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlvIslandPeoples
bools.comment: the island peoples - the Wa and Kozakura populated by a people different from the mainland, most likely an offshoot branch settled in ancient times (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlvJungleTribes
bools.comment: the jungle tribes - the human population thinning south into the isolated tribes (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlvCoastalTributaryStates
bools.comment: the coastal states - the small states trading extensively with the north, paying tribute to Tu Lung or Shou Lung (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlvSnakeEmpireRemnant
bools.comment: the snake empire remnant - the ancient empire deep in the jungle that once held sway over the southern lands, ruled by a race of evil snake creatures possibly yuan-ti, the corrupted and transformed human groups (print capture p. 303)
